status: FROZEN; NOT EXECUTED (evaluation needs the user's approval and about 1-2 GPU hours)
purpose: One confirmatory RepE-LM TEST pass for the persona-representation and causal claims that are VALIDATION-only today.

data.templates: T1-T6, N1-N2 (M1 wording) + T7, T8, N3, N4 (test-only wording, new frames and new slot words)
data.prior_exposure: the 90 source test statements were scored in the retired length-confounded original RepE task; RepE-LM never read them

fitting: Every probe, direction and site is fitted or selected on RepE-LM TRAIN (data/repe/repe_lm/prompts.csv split==train) and applied frozen to TEST. Nothing is tuned on TEST.
sources: M5 source list at layers 1, 8, 11: old ReLU/TopK/JumpReLU-3072 and R2 TopK/BatchTopK/ReLU-12288 and TopK-3072 (3 seeds each); R4 KL/MSE TopK (L8/L11); res-jb; R2 random decoder (control).
positive_controls: original GPT-2 T_full > 0 at each site with 95% CI low > 0 (M3 replication on TEST)
persona KL(H||U) > synonym KL(H||Hp) on TEST (K7 replication)
negative_controls: neutral swaps N1-N4: persona-probe transfer must be <= 0.55 AUROC (floor)
matched-norm isotropic and permuted-feature vectors for every M4 patch (200 draws)

hypotheses.rule: R2 rule (all 9 seed pairs better AND Welch 95% CI excludes 0)

hypotheses.metric: persona-probe AUROC on test-only templates T7/T8 (original activations; probe fit on TRAIN T1-T4)
hypotheses.rule: descriptive; reported with grouped-bootstrap CI against the neutral N3/N4 floor

multiplicity: Holm across the HT1-HT3 cells (12 cells); a hypothesis is CONFIRMED only if every one of its cells passes after correction.
reporting: All cells reported whatever the outcome; a failure to confirm is reported as plainly as a confirmation. TEST rows are used once.
implementation_rule: The TEST evaluation script must be written, smoke-tested on VALIDATION rows only, and its hash added here BEFORE it reads a TEST row.
